request: Create two dashboards with different filters and verify that saving or loading one does not overwrite or contaminate the other.
search_document:
User Request: Create two dashboards with different filters and verify that saving or loading one does not overwrite or contaminate the other.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Monthly Revenue
Type: chart
Description: Monthly revenue trend
Title: Top 10 Products by Sales
Type: chart
Description: Top 10 products based on sales volume
Title: Customer Demographics
Type: table
Description: Summary of customer demographics
Title: Order Status Overview
Type: chart
Description: Overview of order statuses (Pending, Shipped, Delivered)
Title: Sales by Region
Type: chart
Description: Sales distribution across different regions
Title: Supplier Performance
Type: table
Description: Performance metrics for suppliers
Title: Employee Sales Performance
Type: chart
Description: Sales performance metrics by employee
Title: Inventory Levels
Type: chart
Description: Current inventory levels for products

sql_queries.title: Monthly Revenue
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

sql_queries.title: Top 10 Products by Sales
sql_queries.description: Top 10 products based on sales volume
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY TotalQuantity DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Customer Demographics
sql_queries.sql: SELECT cd.CustomerTypeID, cd.CustomerDesc, COUNT(ccd.CustomerID) AS NumberOfCustomers FROM CustomerDemographics cd LEFT JOIN CustomerCustomerDemo ccd ON cd.CustomerTypeID = ccd.CustomerTypeID GROUP BY cd.CustomerTypeID

sql_queries.title: Order Status Overview
sql_queries.description: Overview of order statuses (Pending, Shipped, Delivered)
sql_queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ShippedDate IS NULL THEN 'Pending' WHEN ShippedDate < RequiredDate THEN 'Delivered' ELSE 'Shipped' END AS OrderStatus, COUNT(OrderID) AS NumberOfOrders FROM Orders GROUP BY OrderStatus

sql_queries.title: Sales by Region
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.Region, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.Region

sql_queries.title: Supplier Performance
sql_queries.sql: SELECT s.SupplierID, s.CompanyName, COUNT(p.ProductID) AS NumberOfProducts, SUM(p.UnitsInStock) AS TotalUnitsInStock FROM Suppliers s LEFT JOIN Products p ON s.SupplierID = p.SupplierID GROUP BY s.SupplierID

sql_queries.title: Employee Sales Performance
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.LastName || ', ' || e.FirstName AS EmployeeName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalSales FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

sql_queries.title: Inventory Levels
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, p.UnitsInStock FROM Products p ORDER BY p.UnitsInStock DESC
